subject: Archaeology
subcategory: Lost Cities of the Ancient World
title: Dwarka: India's Sunken Kingdom
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dwarka: India's Sunken Kingdom.

hook.text: Hindu scripture says the god Krishna built a golden city that sank beneath the ocean. Then divers found ruins there.

buildup.text: The Mahabharata describes Dwarka as Krishna's kingdom, swallowed by the sea after his death.

discovery.text: Marine archaeologists found stone walls, anchors, and artifacts off Gujarat's coast dating to around 1500 BCE.

twist.text: The finds match the legendary location but cannot prove the mythological story. Faith and science meet but do not agree.

climax.text: Millions of Hindu pilgrims visit the modern temple at Dwarka, believing the ancient city lies just offshore.

punchline.text: A myth described a sunken city. Divers found one in the same spot.

quiz.question: What complicates the archaeological interpretation of underwater Dwarka?
options: The ruins are too deep for divers to study properly
The finds match the location but cannot prove the mythological story
Modern construction has destroyed most of the underwater evidence
